lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity circular clusters are visible posterior to the gills, arranged in a grid-like formation across the mid-lateral flank. Primary local maxima are observed in approximately five vertical columns with spacing ranging from 20-50 pixels between adjacent centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments to form a series of grid-like nodes. These vertical stripes are most prominent in the region posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient. The upper ridge follows a slightly convex path relative to the dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
